name: environment

import hashlib, importlib.metadata as m, json, platform, sys
from pathlib import Path
packages = ['dpone', 'dpone-native-accel', 'psycopg', 'psycopg-binary', 'pyarrow', 'dbt-core', 'dbt-sqlserver', 'google-cloud-bigquery', 'google-cloud-storage', 'vault-kv-client', 'pytest', 'pytest-xdist']
print(json.dumps({'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(), 'machine': platform.machine(), 'lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path('uv.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'packages': {name: m.version(name) for name in packages}}, indent=2))
